text: LLM Leaderboard - Comparison of AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta & others Comparison and ranking the performance of over 250 AI models (LLMs) across key metrics including intelligence, price, performance and speed (time per task in minutes & latency as time to first answer token), context window & others. For more details including relating to our methodology, see our FAQs. Intelligence Claude Fable 5.2 (max) and Claude Fable 5.2 (xhigh) are the highest intelligence models, followed by GPT-6.2 Astra (max) and Claude Fable 5.2 (high).
